applies_to.quote: instructions on advertising, marketing and sale of financial products / services to all the All India Financial Institutions (hereinafter referred to collectively as “AIFIs” and individually as an “AIFI”)

answer.action: AIFIs must establish comprehensive policies, codes of conduct, and controls for advertising, marketing, and preventing mis-selling and dark patterns.
answer.action_quote: An AIFI shall put in place a comprehensive policy for advertising, marketing and sale of its own as well as third-party financial products / services

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into effect from January 1, 2027.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (All India Financial Institutions – Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
